A '''power tip''' was a weapon component installed on [[Force pike/Legends|force pikes]]. The tip emitted thousands of microscopic vibrations per [[Standard second|second]] when powered by an [[Ultrasonic generator/Legends|ultrasonic vibration generator]]. The ultrasonic charge was transmitted up the pike through [[conductive circuit]]s and allowed the blade to cut through [[Stone/Legends|stone]], metal, flesh, and [[Bone/Legends|bone]].<ref name="EGWT" />
